about: A Zork-like cave exploration. You start in a barrow with a lamp and sword, cross a ravine and a great cavern, and reach a dark tunnel, a marble hall, and a disorienting carousel room.

done.why: After a dozen moves I had found nothing to do except walk through rooms. There were no puzzles, characters or goals, and the carousel room looked like a maze. I'm impatient, so I quit.

moments.note: Moving into a dark place with a grue warning was a familiar touch.
The carousel room scrambled directions, which put me off.
Take all worked and gave short, clean replies.

wished: A clear goal or hook in the first few minutes
Something to interact with besides walking

lines.line: It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
lines.why: The one moment of tension, and a nod to the old Zork games.

fun.why: It was only walking through rooms, with no hook.

engagement.why: Nothing pulled me forward, and the carousel room put me off.

difficulty.why: I met no real challenge in the time I played.

interestingness.why: The Zork-like setting was familiar, but I saw no new ideas in a few minutes.

prose.why: The descriptions were clear and competent, but plain.
